description: Create a listing reel from 10 to 20 EZ Reel photos (assetIds, in running order) on one template and song, as one output per aspect. Motion, timing and cuts are chosen automatically. Nothing is charged: call ez_reel_quote next, show the user the cost, then ez_reel_submit.

aspects.description: One output per aspect. Default ['9:16'] (Reels, Shorts, TikTok).

assetIds.description: From ez_reel_add_photos or ez_reel_import_photos, in order.

listing.description: Listing facts the templates can show as text.

pacing.description: beats = cuts land on the beat; song = the reel runs the length of the song.

name: ez_reel_create
title: Create an EZ Reel
